task.title: Build 67 Strength: root cause proven - reconciliation sends an illegal Idempotency-Key header

result.summary: Event B (400, 0 bytes) was the Founder's workout-reconciliation confirm, rejected at Cloudflare's edge because Native sent its raw idempotency signature (components joined with U+001F) as the Idempotency-Key header; the edge returns an empty 400 for any header containing 0x1F (reproduced read-only, response carries only cf-ray), which validateHTTP maps to server(nil). Event A (200, 2,578 bytes) was HealthKit ingest traffic sharing the same dedicated command transport; production has 7 HealthKit receipts and 0 reconciliation receipts in the window and 0 reconciliation receipts ever. No resubmission occurred. No production mutation: the Sep 24 review is still pending, version 1, resolution null. Fix dc7763e5 sends SHA-256 hex of the same signature (content-deterministic, inside the server's [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{16,200} grammar); RED on Build 67 source, GREEN 1465/1465; fresh-context review PASS.

tests.summary: RED on 8359bdcb (header with \u{1F}); GREEN 1465/1465 unit tests. UI tests not re-run (production-only write path).

review.summary: Fresh-context review PASS: only caller with the defect, idempotency semantics preserved, test asserts on the real outgoing request, FounderServerAPITests 216/216.

unexpected_findings: The defect has existed since the reconciliation flow was introduced (2d79f0b0): no build could ever have committed this command. Earlier builds' -999 failures are most likely the HTTP/2 manifestation of the same invalid header (edge stream reset), not proven.
backlog: Residual risk (reviewer): server-side validation of this command has never run in production; the first post-release confirm is its first real exercise - verify a receipt appears.
recommended_next_step: On authorization, cut the next TestFlight build from dc7763e5 (build-number-only bump); one Founder confirm should then yield a real workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 receipt.
